summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Zeitix Labs landing page. 6/6 pytest backend tests pass covering POST /api/inquiries (success, minimal payload, invalid email 422, missing required 422) and GET /api/inquiries (sorted desc, no _id leak). Frontend E2E via Playwright validated page load, hero heading, all 6 sections (navbar, hero, products, whyus, roadmap, contact, footer), 5 product cards (Play/CRM/Tools/Grow/Build), all 4 nav links scrolling correctly with Lenis smooth scroll, direct contact links (mailto/tel/wa.me), empty-form validation shows error toast with NO API call, and successful form submission (POST 200 + form cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as isoformat string in Mongo then re-parses in GET; acceptable but inconsistent — consider storing as native datetime and letting motor handle it.
No pagination on GET /api/inquiries (hard limit 1000); fine for MVP but will need pagination at scale.
No rate-limiting on public POST /api/inquiries — could be abused by bots. Consider captcha/honeypot for production.
Frontend Contact.jsx does not validate email format client-side beyond input type='email'; relies on backend 422. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed inquiries via API tests and one UI inquiry (TEST_UI_User / test_ui@example.com). Not cleaned up — low volume, no production concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features in review request verified working. If retesting, note sonner success toast auto-dismisses in ~4s — check for toast within 2-3s after submit, OR verify form fields cleared as a proxy for success.
